subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Usar procedimentos de checagem de fatos noticiados e fotos publicadas (verificar/avaliar veículo, fonte, data e local da publicação, autoria, URL, formatação; comparar diferentes fontes; consultar ferramentas e sites checadores etc.), de forma a combater a proliferação de notícias falsas (fake news).

components.description_pt: Verificar a credibilidade de um veículo de notícias usando critérios de verificação de fatos predefinidos
components.description_en: Verify the credibility of a news outlet using predefined fact-checking criteria
components.cc_component_description: Assess the credibility of print and digital sources used in research

components.description_pt: Conferir uma notícia reportada em múltiplas fontes independentes
components.description_en: Cross-reference a reported news story across multiple independent sources
components.cc_component_description: Assess the accuracy of information across multiple media sources on the same topic

components.description_pt: Avaliar elementos de metadados—data, local, autoria e URL—para avaliar autenticidade de notícias
components.description_en: Evaluate metadata elements—date, location, authorship, and URL—to assess news authenticity
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the date and origin of a historical or social studies source when citing evidence

components.description_pt: Usar ferramentas e sites de verificação de fatos para identificar informações falsas ou enganosas
components.description_en: Use fact-checking tools and websites to identify false or misleading information
components.cc_component_description: Identify false statements or fallacious reasoning within an informational text

components.description_pt: Detectar fotografias digitalmente manipuladas ou descontextualizadas usando procedimentos de verificação
components.description_en: Detect digitally manipulated or miscontextualized photographs using verification procedures

cc_matches.description: Integrate multiple sources of information presented in diverse media or formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively, orally) evaluating the credibility and accuracy of each source.

Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources; assess the credibility of each source; and quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and providing basic bibliographic information for sources.
Cite specific textual evidence to support analysis of primary and secondary sources, attending to such features as the date and origin of the information.

Delineate and evaluate the argument and specific claims in a text, assessing whether the reasoning is valid and the evidence is relevant and sufficient; identify false statements and fallacious reasoning.
